definition: string of a musical instrument; {khausai lasakna} is an instrument with strings

<khausan> with the plural <te>; in a list of costly cloth, where the English has scarlet cloth
coarse cloth; {khautang puan} is a garment of sackcloth, worn in mourning or repentance
<khau> and <tawh> written as one word: with or by means of a rope, cord or cable
<khau>, cord, with the plural <te>: cords, ropes, or in lists of cloth, yarn
a whip made of cords, <khau>; the same verse in the other text has <khautep>
a whip made of cords, <khau>; the same verse in the other text has <khauteep>
loop of cord set on the ground to catch something; <khau> is cord

work a field to grow crops; {lo khawh} is farm a field and {lo khawh hun} is ploughing time
prepare and work land or plants so that they bear a crop

<khawhlawhsak>, let land out to tenants, with the linking ending <in>: having let it out

<khawh> in the sense spear or stab, with <let>, right through: stab so that the weapon goes through

<khawh>, work the soil, with the ending {-na}; {lo khawhna tu} is the tool for tilling a field, a plowshare or hoe

<khawh> farm with <sa>, already done: what one has grown; {khawhsa tawh biakna}, offering of produce

<khawhsa>, what one has grown, with the plural <te>
keep and not kill, often as {hing khawi}, keep alive; in Ecclesiastes 3:3 it is the opposite of killing

<khawi>, keep or rear, with <pa> marking a man; {tuu khawipa} is a man who raises sheep
<khawi>, keep or rear, with <sa>, already done: an animal that one keeps, livestock or a pet; named beside <neihsa> and <khawhsa>
<khawi>, rear or keep animals, with plural {-te}: animals that are kept; {gan khawite} is livestock and {ui khawite} are house dogs

<khawlmun>, a place to stop and rest, with the plural <te>; of ships, a harbour

the end of the foot, the toes; often paired with <khutdawn>, the fingertips
king of Elam who led the alliance of four kings that was defeated by Abram

put one thing in the place of another, as clothes; with <tawh>, exchange something for something else
twist fibre into thread or cord

the cutting open of a body; in news reports the examination of a dead body, glossed with post-mortem
to put one thing in the place of another, as clothes, skin or an animal for offering
footprint; used for the way of life of someone that another person follows

<khekhap>, footstep, with <teng>, all: the whole way of life of someone that another follows

<khiam>, reduce, with <suk>, downward

form of <khia> used after a verb when another word such as <phetin>, <ciangin> or <ding> follows

terms: be able to get out/manage to

terms: will be able to get out/can be put in

terms: cannot get out/unable to bring out

<khiat>, interpret, with the noun suffix <na>: the meaning of words or the interpretation of a dream

plural of <khiatna>, the meaning or interpretation of a dream

<khiatpih>, bring out, with the noun suffix <na>, after <pai>

<khoih>, touch, with <khakna.1>, the fact of happening to, written as one word: a touching of something, contact with it
<khoih>, touch, doubled: touch again and again, keep handling or fiddling with something, as a phone
<khoih> and <sak> written as one word: touch what belongs to another person, or touch another person's body
<khoi>, care for, with the noun suffix <na>: the care or support given to someone; here paired with <vaak>, feed
<khoi>, rear, with <sa>, already done: whom one has brought up
<khoi>, rear, with <sak>, for someone: nurse or bring up a child on behalf of another
take the bark or skin off a plant or tree; {ahawng ki khok} is its bark is stripped
<kho>, farm, with <khawm>, together: plow a field with two animals yoked together
take off the outer skin or bark of something, with <khia>, out or off; {singhawng khokkhia} is strip off the bark
put food or goods away to keep for later use
put money or wealth aside for the future; {sum khol} is save money
after another verb, shows that the action is done ahead of time, as in {kiging khol} prepare in advance, {gen khol} tell beforehand and {thei khol lo} not know beforehand; not the verb store or save
<khol>, store, with <cip>, tightly, and the plural <te>: those who hoard things for themselves
placed after a verb for doing something ahead of time: {theih kholh} foreknow, {ngaihsut kholh} think out beforehand; a form of <khol>
take or send a share of food to others who have none

terms: to do beforehand/to do in advance
definition: <kholh>, beforehand, with <ding>, to, written as one word after a verb: what is to be done ahead of time, as {kigin kholhding}, to prepare in advance
<kholh>, beforehand, and the negative <loh> written as one word, placed after a verb: not having done it in advance
noun form of <kholh>, beforehand, placed after a verb: an act done in advance, as {thupiak kholhna} revelation, {thugen kholhna} foretelling, {kisak kholhna} readiness
<kholhna> written with a capital in a title; {Thugen Kholhna}, foretelling, is the prophecy of Ahijah
<kholh> beforehand with <na> and the plural <te>, after a verb of speaking: things said in advance, as {thugen kholhnate} predictions and {hilh kholhnate} warnings
spend time with someone as a companion; with the prefix <ki>, keep company with each other, as in <kikholh>
<kholhpih>, keep company with, with the plural <te>: the people one keeps company with
<kholh>, beforehand, with <sa>: follows a verb and marks the action as already done ahead of time
<kholh> beforehand with <sak> for someone, after a verb: {koih kholhsak} is lay up or reserve for someone ahead of time
<kholhsak>, beforehand for someone, with the noun suffix <na>: {a bawl kholhsakna mun} is the place made ready in advance for her
<kholh>, beforehand, with the plural <te>, after a verb: {thugen kholhte} is the words spoken beforehand, predictions

<kholh>, beforehand, and <theih>, be able, written as one word after a verb: {kiging kholhtheih} is be able to prepare in advance; in one article it follows <ki> and seems to be <kikholh>, associate, with <theih>
<khol>, beforehand, with the linking suffix <in>: follows a verb whose action is done ahead of time, before a further action
<khol>, store, with the linking suffix <in>, before a further action
placed after a verb or a describing word, like <khollo> with <kei> in place of <lo>: not particularly, not to any great degree
placed after a verb, the ending {-khol}, beforehand, said twice: the thing is seen, said or thought out before it happens, as {mu kholkhol}, see beforehand
follows a verb or a describing word: not particularly, not to any great degree
form of <khollo> used before <hangin>, <bang> and <te>
<kholloh>, not much, with plural <te>, after a verb: the ones that are not much so; {thupi i sak khollohte}, the parts we do not think very important

terms: those who hardly/those who do not much
definition: <khollo> not much with plural <te>: {a paupau khollote} is those who do not talk much
<khol>, store, with the noun suffix <na>: the storing of something or the place where it is stored; {sum kholna} is a treasury or treasure
after a verb, <kholh>, beforehand, with the noun suffix <na>: the doing of something ahead of time, as {gen kholna}, a foretelling, and {lungngaih kholna}, thinking ahead; nothing is stored
<kholna> storing place with <pi> great: {nin kholnapi} is a great rubbish heap, where the NIV has heap of ruins
<khol> and <lo>, not, written as one word after a verb or describing word: not especially, not really so; {om kholo ding} is would hardly exist
<khol>, beforehand, with <pa>, the man who, after a verb: {thu pia kholpa}, he who warns, {a om kholpa}, he who stands ready
<khol>, store, with <sa>, already done: things that have been laid up, stores or treasure
follows a verb: done or made ready ahead of time, as {kigelh kholsa} written beforehand and {kiseh kholsa} determined beforehand; {kholsa-a om} is be prepared
<khol>, beforehand, with <sak>, for someone, after a verb: {hilh kholsak} is warn someone beforehand
<kholsa>, what is stored up, with the plural <te>
<khol> store with the plural <te>: the things that have been stored

terms: those who store/those who gather in
definition: <khol> store with the plural <te>: the people who have gathered and stored the crop
<khol>, store, with <teng>, all: the whole of what one has laid up

terms: be able to save/can save up
definition: <khol>, save, and <thei>, able, written as one word: be able to put money aside

terms: be able to do beforehand/can do in advance
definition: <khol>, here beforehand, as in <kholh>, and <thei>, able, written as one word after a verb: {gen kholthei} is be able to say in advance and {ngaihsun kholthei} be able to think ahead
<khol>, store, with <zaw>, rather: store up there instead
<khol>, store, with <zo>, be able: succeed in storing up
of food or goods, be enough to last through a length of time
after a pronoun, as in {keima khomin}: by myself, for my own part
bread or a loaf of bread
<khomun> written with a capital at the start of a sentence or in the name {Silngo om lo Khomun}, the Unleavened Bread of the festival
<khomun>, loaf, with the plural <te>; here the consecrated bread set before God
collect money or a tax from people
used with <khai>: {khong khai} means practise sorcery or soothsaying, and {khong khaite} are those who do so
after a verb: merely staying in that state without doing anything more, as in {bu khong}, stay hidden, and {en khong}, only look on
another spelling of <khawng>, after a noun, a place or a number: that and things like it, or about that much, as {TV khong} and {Falam khong ah}
in {a khong in} before a verb of giving: without payment, as a free gift
always in {a khongin}: as a free gift, without payment or wages
occult art; {khongkhai siamte} and {khongkhai theite}, those skilled in it, stand for the astrologers and enchanters of Babylon and Egypt
<khongkhai> with the noun suffix <na>: the practice of the occult art
<khongkhai>, sorcery or soothsaying, with plural <te>: those who practise it, named beside <aisante>, diviners
<khongkhai>, occult art, with <thei>, know: one who knows that art
<khongkhaithei>, one who knows the occult art, with the plural <te>
door or doorway with the place marker <ah>; the same verse writes <kongkhak> for door
placed after a verb and its markers: the thing comes about at last, after long effort or delay, as in {hong zo khongkhong}, they managed it in the end
name used in Manipur for the <Kuki> people; also a family name among them
placed after a verb, the action is done together with someone; form of <khawm> used before words such as <ding>, <sangin> and <man>
placed after a describing word or a verb: to a sufficient degree; {sauvei khop} is long enough and {kham khop} is enough to satisfy
bring together or gather in people, money or a harvest; the form of <khawm> used before words such as <uh>, <ding> and <nading>
postpositional marker to indicate objective case
particle suffixed to a noun to form verb past tense
<khop> and <ding> written as one word after a verb: to do it together, as in {kipawl khopding}, to unite, and {nasep khopding}, to work together
<khop>, enough, with <in>, written as one word after a verb or after <zah>: to the point that, so much that
placed after a describing word: to some degree, a certain amount; {a gamla khopkhat}, some distance away
<khop>, together, with {-na}, placed after a verb: the doing of it together, as {kipawl khopna}, an alliance, and {lup khopna}, lying together as man and wife
<khop>, gather, with {-na}: the gathering in of a harvest

<khopna>, the doing of something together, with <nei>, have: placed after a verb, hold a joint session of that action, as {kimuh khopna nei}, hold a meeting, and {thunget khopna nei}, hold a prayer meeting
plural of <khopna>, doing together, placed after a verb; in the articles only in {pan khopnate}, the things done side by side, joint efforts
<khop>, gather, with the augmentative {-pi}: a large gathering of a church body or organisation; {ki khoppi} is hold such a gathering
placed after a verb, the action is done together with someone or something: {lup khoppih} lie with, sleep with; {meek khoppih} mix with
<khop>, gather, with the causative <sak>: cause people to come together
<khopsak>, gather, with the linking suffix <in>, before a further command
<khop>, gather, with the plural <te>: the ones whom someone has gathered together
<khop>, enough, with <zah>, amount: {khe a ta khopzah} is as much ground as a foot can stand on
town in Galilee near Capernaum that Jesus rebuked for not repenting
<kho>, farm, with the causative <sak>: have someone else work a field or vineyard
press someone strongly to do or not to do a thing

<kho> in its meaning stand firm, as in <kipkho>, with the causative <sak>: make a thing stand firm and lasting, said of love or of a thought; comes after <kip> or {kiptak in}, and has nothing to do with farming
of goods, find buyers, be sold in quantity; {van khot} is goods sell
<kho>, firm, with <takin>, which makes an adverb: firmly; often with <len>, hold
<kho>, farm, with the plural <te>: those who work the land, in {lo khote}, farmers or tenants
in {sum khotte}, the money got in, here from selling possessions; <khot> seems to be the form of <khon>, collect, used before <te>
manage to check or hold back someone, by urging or by force; <kho>, urge or restrain, with <zo>, be able
Christ, the Messiah, title of Jesus as the one anointed by God; the spelling used beside <Khazih>
a precious stone, the seventh foundation stone of the new Jerusalem, counted among the <suangmanpha>, precious stones
precious stone, the tenth foundation stone of the new Jerusalem; chrysoprase, where the NIV has turquoise
a follower of Christ, the name first given to the disciples at Antioch; also describes a thing as Christian, as in {Khristian mipih}, fellow Christian
<Khristian>, Christian, and <biakna>, religion: the usual name of the Christian faith as one religion among others
<Khristian>, Christian, with <nuntakna>, life: the life a believer leads as a follower of Christ; often after a possessive such as <i> or <na>
<Khristian> with the noun suffix {-na}: the being Christian of a person or a people, their Christian faith and life
<Khristian> with <pih> fellow and <te> plural: those who are Christians together with one; stands where the NIV has brothers and sisters
<Khristian> with the plural <te>: Christians, believers in Christ; often stands where the English has brothers and sisters or in the Lord
precious stone, first of the fourth row on the breastpiece, where the NIV has topaz
smoke rising from a fire or from incense; more often in the compound <meikhu>
give off smoke, smolder; said twice, {khu khu}, for smoldering on and on
put on or wear something on the head, such as a hat, crown or helmet
word indicating a particular mood of light or dark
a town or city, a place where many people live together; {khua sung} is inside the town and {khua mite} are its people
a village or small settlement, often said with <neu>, small, or <no>, little
the weather or time of year, in {khua hun}, season
in <Khuado>, by the statement of the book, not the village that can be seen but what cannot be seen, <khuazing> and <khuavak>, the <dawi> and <kau>
<khua> written with a capital, in a title or at the start of a sentence; {Shiloh Khua Mi} is the man of the town of Shiloh, the Shilonite
<khua>, village, and <kipawlna>, association: the association of the people who come from one village, formed where they now live; the name of the village stands before it

<khua>, village, <le>, and, and <tui>, water, literally village and water: the village one belongs to and its people, the home community and its common good; it stands after a possessive such as <i> or <na>, and beside {beh le phung}, clan and family, and {gam le nam}, land and nation
set pair of <khua>, village, and <tui>, water: the village and its water, the community one belongs to and its common life
<khua>, village or town, and <makai>, leader: a leader of a village, and among Zomi abroad a leader of the people who come from one home village
dull, overcast weather, when the sky is dark with cloud

<khua> with <phawknawnlo>, no longer be aware: {khua phawk} is be conscious, aware of what is around, and with <nawnlo>, no longer, it says that a hurt or sick person passes out; <khua> here is not season or village; {khua hongphawkkik} is come round again
<khua>, town or village, with the place ending <ah>: in or at the town
the moisture that comes out of the skin in heat or hard work; {khua-ul kai} is to sweat

terms: in the village/to the village/in the town
definition: <khua> and <ah> written as one word: in or to the village or town; after a name, in the village of that name
a rite of the traditional Zomi religion kept by the whole village, glossed in the articles as {tual biakna}; named beside <Khuado>
the Foundation Gate in Jerusalem, {Khuabul Kulh kongpi}, where a third of the guards were posted when Joash was made king
<khua>, town or village, with <bup>, whole: all of a town or village and all its people
<khua>, town or village, with <buppi>, whole: the entire town and all its people
<khua>, village or town, and <ciat>, each, written as one word: each village, every one's own town
<khua>, town, with <cing>, guard: one who keeps watch over a town or a post; {khuacing mite} are the men of an outpost
<khuacing>, guard a town, with the linking ending <in>: keeping guard over a town, defending it
plural of <khuacing>, those who guard a town; a body of soldiers stationed in a place
<khua>, the surroundings, with <dak>, look: raise the eyes and look around; {khuadak to} is look up and {khuadak kawikawi} is look all around
<khuadak>, look, with <dak> repeated for an action that goes on: keep looking
<khuadak>, look, with <in>, the linking form before a following verb: looking up or around and then doing something
<khuadak>, look around, with the noun ending <na>: keeping a lookout; {khuadakna tausang} is a watchtower
<khuadak>, look around, and <siam>, skilled, written as one word: watch the situation carefully and wisely before acting, wait and see
<khuadak>, look, with <suk>, downward: look down from a higher place
<khuadak>, look around, with <to>, up
<khuadak>, look, with <toh>, upward: the form of <khuadakto> used before <leh>
<khuadak> look with <zo> be able; with {nawn lo}, no longer able to look
<khua>, the weather, with <dam>, cold: cold weather or the feeling of cold
<khuadam>, cold weather, and <lua>, very, written as one word: it is very cold, the weather being too cold
<khuadam>, cold weather, with the noun suffix {-na}: the cold, and before <mun> or <gam> a cold place or country
<khuadam>, cold, with <pi>, great: severe cold
<khua> town with <dang> other

terms: to the other towns/in the other villages
definition: <khuadang> other town with plural <te> and the place marker <ah>
the traditional harvest and new year festival of the Zomi, kept after the harvest around October; often {Khuado pawi}, the Khuado festival, with <pawi>

<Khuado>, the harvest and new year festival of the Zomi, and <pawipi>, great feast: the Khuado festival as a public celebration, the usual name of the event held by Zomi communities; a place name may stand before it
a month of the traditional Zomi calendar, set beside October in the book's table of month names
in the verse with <lo>: {khuadon lo} is not expecting, not watching
<Khuado> and <ni>, day, written as one word: the day of the Khuado festival
the Khuado, the traditional festival of the Zomi kept after the harvest, with <pawi>, festival; also written {Khuado pawi}
<Khuado> with <pi> in the sense of great: the great Khuado festival
the material of which the loops of the tabernacle curtains were made
<khua>, town, with <gei>, edge or side: the area at the edge of a town

terms: near the town/vicinity of the town
definition: <khua>, town, and <geinai>, near, written as one word, placed after the name of a town: the area near that town
wash the inside of something with water, as the mouth or a tank; {kam khuah} is rinse the mouth
paired with <gamtat>, way of living
make hard or strong: {lungsim khuahsak}, harden the heart, {tha khuahsak}, strengthen; the same in meaning as <khauhsak>
the state of the weather at a given time; {khuahun hoih} is good weather
<khuahun>, weather or the state of things, and <kikhel>, be changed: the weather or climate changes, and of politics or society the times change; as a noun, climate change or changing times
<khuahun>, climate, and <kikhelna>, change: the term for climate change in news of the world, often as {leitung khuahun kikhelna} or {leitungbup khuahun kikhelna}, global climate change

terms: trend of the times/course of events/current situation
definition: <khuahun>, the state of things, with <luanzia>, the way something flows: the way the times are moving, the present trend or situation; {leitung khuahun luanzia} is world trends, and {khuahun luanzia zui in} is in keeping with the situation
<khuahun>, weather, and <sia>, bad: bad weather, also said of a climate that is getting worse; used as a noun or as a statement, {khuahun sia mahmah} is the weather is very bad
<khuahun>, here the weather, and <siatna>, ruin: bad weather or a disaster brought by weather, such as a storm or flood; often followed by <hangin>, because of

terms: according to circumstances/as the times go/in season
definition: <khuahun>, the weather, season or state of things, and <zui>, follow: followed by <in> or <a>, in keeping with the season or with how the situation stands at the time; said also of people who change sides as the situation changes
<khuahun> and the topic marker <pen> written as one word: the weather, as what the sentence is about
<khuahun>, weather or condition, with <sia>, bad: bad weather, and so a bad time
plural of <khuahun>: the seasons of the year, in {hun leh khuahunte}, times and seasons
plural of <khuahun> in its meaning of the state of things: the conditions of a country or of the world, as in {gamvai khuahunte}, not the seasons of the year
the honey bee; {khuai hon} is a swarm of bees and <khuaizu> is honey
<khuai>, bee, with <aih>, perform a rite: the rite for the bees on the third day of <Khuado>; {khuai-aih ni} is the day on which it is held
the Zomi custom of celebrating over bees taken from the hive: the bees are not burned or eaten but let fly away alive, which the book explains as giving freedom

<khuai-aih> with the noun ending <na>: the rite in which bees are honoured and set free, which the book explains as a pledge that people and bees will guard one another, so that the bees keep the flies from a person who dies

in the old Zomi custom, the feast held for <khuai>, bees, with <aih> and the noun ending <na>; like other feasts it was planned for the time after death, so that flies would not swarm on the dead body

terms: day of the bee rite/third day of Khuado
definition: <khuai-aih> and <ni>, day, written as one word: the third of the three days of <Khuado>, on which the rite for the bees is held and wasp nests are opened to foretell the year
<khuai>, bee, with <bu>, nest: the comb in which bees store honey
<khuai>, bee, with <khau>, rope: a rope that goes with the taking of a bees' nest; the young men hold it as they come home in procession with the nest on the day before <Khuado>
<khuai>, bee, and <la>, take, written as one word: take a nest of bees in the forest, a custom of the Khuado festival; the noun is <khuailak>
<khuai>, bee, with <la>, song: the song sung by those who come back from taking the bees' nest at Khuado

terms: taking of the bees' nest/bee nest taking
definition: <khuai>, bee, with <lak>, take: the taking of a nest of bees at the <Khuado> festival, when the comb is examined to foretell the coming year

terms: taking of the bees' nest/bee nest taking
definition: <khuailak> with the noun ending {-na}: the taking of a nest of bees, a custom of the <Khuado> festival by which the coming year is foretold
honey still in the comb, named beside <khuaizu>, honey, as the sweetest of foods
a wax candle, <khuai>, bee, with <mei>, fire or light
<khuai> bee, wax, with <meivak> lamp: {khuaimeivak vakna khuam} is a lampstand

a kind of wild bee or wasp, the last of the five kinds the book lists as those that can be taken for the rite of <Khuado>, after <tuunpi>, <ngaltuun>, <ngalthen> and <khuaithuum>; the exact kind is not determined
the young of the <khuai>, bee, taken from the comb and eaten as a delicacy in Zogam
<khuai>, bee, with <no>, young, and the plural ending <te>: the young of the bees in the comb
the wax made by bees, which melts before the fire
<khuai>, bee, with <pheng>, slab: a comb of the bees' nest, holding honey and young bees
a swarming, stinging bee; {khuaipi nam tunpi} is used for the hornet
<khuaipi>, bee, with <zu>, liquid: honey, the honeycomb of the NIV
the losing of a child by death, in {ta khuaisuahna}, loss of children
{khuaisuah}, lose a child by death, with <te>: people who have lost a child
plural of <khuai>: bees

a kind of wild bee or wasp, one of the five kinds the book lists as those that can be taken for the rite of <Khuado>, with <tuunpi>, <ngaltuun>, <ngalthen> and <khuaimu>; the exact kind is not determined
<khuai>, bee, with <zu>, liquid: honey; the promised land is described as flowing with {bawngnawi leh khuaizu}, milk and honey
cut into rock or a hard surface, as a tomb in rock; {khuak-in at} is to engrave
the brain inside the head, and the power to think and remember that goes with it, as in {khuak hoih}, a good brain; a noun, not the verb hew
the brain, as an organ of the body and as the seat of thinking and memory
<khuak>, brain, and <ciim>, sensible, written as one word: having a good mind and sound judgement; used for intelligence as measured by IQ
named after <khuapi> city and <khuaneu> village as the smallest kind of settlement
the hot, dry season of the year
<khuakhal>, summer, and <hun>, time, written as one word: the hot, dry season
<khua> and <khat> written as one word: one village or town, a single town, a whole village
<khua> town repeated, with <in>

terms: upper end of the village/head of the village
definition: <khua>, village, with <khung>, the upper end: the upper side of a village and the ground next to it; after a village name, the upper end of that village
<khua> town with <kiim> around: the country round a town
<khua>, village or town, with <kim>, the area around: the country and villages round about a place; {khuakim khuapam} is the neighbouring villages
<khuak> carve with linking <in>: {khuakin ki-at} is be engraved
<khua>, town, with <kongpi>, main gate: the gate of a walled town
plural of <khuakongpi>: the gates of a walled town
<khuak>, brain, and <pil>, wise, written as one word: having a brain that works well; also used as a verb, be mentally sharp
<khuak>, here brain, and <sung>, inside, written as one word: the inside of the brain, the brain as the place of thought and of illness; {khuaksung nasepna} is the working of the brain
<khua>, town, with <kulh>, wall: the wall built round a town for its defence

terms: on the city wall/at the wall
definition: <khuakulh> city wall with the place marker <ah>
<khuakulh>, city wall, with <pi>, great: the great wall round a town
away from home, on a journey: used with <zin>, travel, as in {khual gamlapi-ah zin}, go on a long journey

terms: care for/be considerate of/be concerned for
definition: think of another person with concern and kindness, often beside <hehpih>, pity, or <vei>, feel for; used without <zin>, unlike the sense journey

terms: far country/distant place away from home
definition: <khual>, a place away from home, and <gamla>, far: a far-off place where one is a stranger; mostly before <zin>, journey, as {khual gamla zin}, travel far from home
set pair of <khual>, one from elsewhere, and <tual>, one of the place: outsiders and local people together
<khua>, town or village, with <lai>, here the middle: the central part of a town or village; also the name of a central ward, as {Khualai veng} in Tedim
<khua>, town, and <laizang>, middle, written as one word: the central part of a town or city
<khua>, town, and <lak>, midst, written as one word: out among the houses and people of a town, away from home; {khualak vak} is go about the town

terms: direction of the town/way to the town
definition: <khua>, town, and <lam>, direction, written as one word after the name of a town: toward that town; {Ipoh khualam zuanin} is heading for Ipoh
<khua>, village, and <lam>, side, written as one word: the home village, or the villages as against the town; {khualam ah ciah} is go back home to the village
<khua>, <leh> and <tui>, village and water, written as one word: one's home village and community, the common good of one's people
<khua>, village, <le>, and, and <tui>, water, written as one word: one's village and its people, the community one belongs to

terms: foreign land/land away from home/strange land
definition: <khual>, away from home, and <gam> written as one word: a land or place that is not one's home
<khual>, away from home, and <gamla>, far, written as one word: a place far from home, or away at a great distance
<khual>, away from home, with <hawh>, visit: go away to another place, here to look for an animal for the household
<khual> in the sense of caring about or taking into account, with <in>: thinking of, for the sake of, as one’s future, children or people
the dry season: {khualkhal hun} is summertime; written <khuakhal> elsewhere
<khual> in the sense have regard for, care about, with the negative <lo>, written as one word: without regard for, not considering
<khual>, away from home, with <mi>, person: someone living in a place that is not his own
<khualmi>, foreigner, with <pa>, which marks a man: a foreigner living among the people
plural of <khualmi>: people from elsewhere who live among another people
<khual>, have regard for, with the noun suffix <na>: care or regard for someone; {ka khualna-in} means for the sake of
<khualna>, care or regard for someone, with the plural <te>: the ways in which someone has cared for another
<khual>, away from home, with <pa>, which marks a man: a man from elsewhere living among the people
<khual> with the plural <te>; in {mi khualte}, people from elsewhere who live among another people

terms: those who have regard for/those who consider

<kiang>, presence or side, with the place marker <ah>: to, beside or with a person; it follows the person who is spoken to or approached

<kiangah>, to or with a person, and <zong>, also, written as one word after the person named
from a person, from the presence of someone; <kiang> with <pan>, more often written {kiang panin}
from a person or from the presence of someone; <kiangpan> with the suffix <in>
<ki> and <angtanpih> written as one word: the group as a whole is proud of someone or of what was achieved
<ap>, hand over, with the passive prefix <ki>: be entrusted to someone; of a list, be handed in; {sang kiap} is to enrol at a school
<kia>, fall, and <pahpah>, here each one in turn, written as one word: fall or crash again and again, said of aircraft
<kia>, fall, with the causative <sak>: make fall, bring a person down from a high place, or send down hail or birds from the sky
after <thong>, prison: send someone to prison by the judgment of a court; {thong ki kiasak} is be sentenced to prison, often after the length of the term
<kiasak>, send to prison, and <ding>, the marker of what is to come, written as one word; {thong kum 1 sung ki kiasakding} is will be sentenced to one year in prison
<kiasak>, cause to fall, with the linking suffix <in>

terms: can be sentenced to/may be jailed
definition: <kiasak>, cause to fall, and <thei>, can, written as one word; with <thong>, prison, and the passive <ki>: can be sent to prison, as the penalty a law allows
<kia>, fall, with <suk>, downward: fall or come down from a higher place
<kiasuk>, fall down, with the linking suffix <in>
<kiasuk>, fall down, and <kik>, back, written as one word: fall back to the ground after going up, as an aircraft after take-off
<kiasuk>, fall down, with <mawk>, which marks the event as unexpected, written as one word: fall or crash down all at once
<kiasuk>, fall down, with <suak>, right through: fall all the way down from a height or into a hole
form of <kia>, fall, used before <leh>, <ciangin>, <sangin>, <manin> and other endings
used with <lung>, heart: {lung a kiat}, the heart falls, means one is discouraged or grows faint
cut hair off close with a blade, or scrape a surface; {kiat khia} is shave off or scrape away
<kia> and <ta> written as one word: has fallen; said of the sun that has set and of a town taken in war; {lung kiata} is has lost heart
<kiat> and <ding> written as one word: will fall, to fall; {thong kiatding} is the prison term to be served

terms: those that fall/fallen ones/what has fallen
definition: <kia>, fall, with the plural <te>: things that have fallen, as seed, grapes or crumbs
<kia>, fall, and <thei>, can, written as one word: can fall; after <thong> and a length of time it means may be sentenced to prison for that long
<kia>, <thei> and <ding> written as one word: may fall, is liable to fall; <thong kiatheiding> is may be sent to prison
<kiat>, shave or scrape, with the linking suffix <in>; said of shaving the hair and of scraping the walls of a house
<kiat>, scrape, with <khia>, out or away, and the linking suffix <in>: scraping something away
<kiat>, scrape, with <khiat>, off or away; {a kiatkhiat} is what has been scraped off

terms: have shaved off/cause to be shaved off
definition: <kiatkhiat>, shave or scrape off, with the causative <sak>: have something shaved off

terms: fall as a result/end up in
definition: <kiat>, fall, with <lawh>, as a consequence, written as one word: fall or crash because of something; {thong kiatlawh} is end up in prison for it
the act of falling, from <kiat>, fall, with the noun suffix <na>; {za kiatna} is loss of office and {thong kiatna} is being put in prison
in {mul kiatna}, a tool for shaving hair, from <kiat>, shave, with the noun suffix <na>

terms: fall together with/share a fall with
definition: <kiat>, form of <kia>, fall, with <pih>, together with; {thong kiatpih} is to be in prison together with someone, a fellow prisoner
<kiat>, fall, with the causative <sak>: make fall or send down; {thong kiatsak} is put in prison and {za kiatsak} is remove from a position
<kiat>, scrape, with the causative <sak> and the linking suffix <in>: having something scraped
<kiat>, shave, with <siang>, clean: shave away all the hair or beard
<kiat>, fall, with <suah>, let out: let something slip and fall by accident, or of the thing itself, fall off or fall out
<kiat>, fall, and <theih>, be able, written as one word before <nading>: so that one can fall; after <thong> and a length of time, can be sentenced to prison for that long
<kiat>, fall, and <theih>, can, with the noun suffix <na>: the possibility of falling; {kiattheihna ding gum} is a pit that one can fall into
placed after a verb, often before <se> or <hi>, to say that it is only so, or done lightly or in passing; {om kiau se hi} is there is just the one
placed after a verb: it happens off and on or in scattered cases, not steadily

terms: be put on/be laid on/be worn
definition: <baang>, put on, with the passive prefix <ki>: of a yoke, be laid on an animal; of clothing, be put on a person

terms: owe one another/be in debt to one another
definition: <ki>, one another, with <ba>, owe, here written with a long vowel, and <sak>: be left owing each other something, as in Romans 13:8
<bah>, put food to the mouth, with <ki>: feed each other by hand or be given food, as a sign of love; in the saying {Ciimnuai-a sa kibah Geeltui-ah kithuk} a kindness is repaid later
in {a kibaih sa in om}, stand ready beforehand for someone; one other sentence has it as be taken easily or lightly, of marriage and divorce
<bak> with the prefix <ki>: put pieces of meat into each other's mouths at a feast as a sign of affection, in {sa kibak}; see <sabak>

terms: be torn to pieces/be cut in pieces
definition: <balnen>, tear in pieces, with the passive prefix <ki>; often followed by <gawp>, violently

terms: be torn to pieces/be cut in pieces
definition: <kibalnen>, be torn to pieces, with <gawp>, violently
<balzan>, tear apart, with the passive prefix <ki>: said of a person or animal torn by a wild beast

terms: keep up with/catch up with/be equal to
definition: <ban>, reach, with <ki>: come level with others, be their equal; mostly with <zo> and a negative, as in {kiban zo nailo}, not yet able to keep up with
be like; the thing compared with is followed by <tawh>, so that <tawh kibang> means is like
the same, not different; {a kibang} before a noun means the same, as in {ngeina a kibang khat}, one and the same law
something that is like another; {tawh a kibang khat} is one that looks like
<kibang>, same, and <kimlo>, not all: the things named before it are not all the same, they differ from one to another; stands at the end of the clause before <hi> or <ding>

terms: be just the same/be just like/be no different
definition: <kibang>, be alike, and <lel>, here the particle just, merely, not the verb lose: be simply the same; after a noun with <tawh>, be just like it, be no more than it
<kibang>, be alike, with the linking ending <a> before another verb; {tawh kibanga kibawl} means made to be like, as in {ngen tawh kibanga kibawl}, made like a net, the network on the temple pillars

terms: remain the same/stay as it is
definition: <kibang>, be the same, with <bang> repeated: go on being the same, remain as it is

terms: will be like/will be the same
definition: <kibang> and <ding> written as one word, mostly after <tawh>: will be like, will be the same as
<kibang>, be like, and the sentence ending <hi> written as one word: is like, is the same as; the thing compared with takes <tawh>
<kibang>, be alike, with the suffix <in>: alike, equally; after <tawh>, in the same way as
<kibang>, be like, with <kha>, happen to: after <tawh>, may seem to be
<kibang>, same, with <kim>, all: all alike, all the same
<kibang>, be like, with <lai>, still: after <tawh>, still be like
<kibang> and <lel> written as one word: merely the same, no different, mostly after <tawh>
<kibang>, the same, with <lian>, here exactly, written as one word; what it is compared with is followed by <tawh>

terms: not exactly the same/not quite alike
definition: <kibanglian>, exactly the same, and <lo>, not, written as one word: not exactly alike, differing somewhat
<kibang> and <lo> written as one word: not alike, different from each other

<kibang>, alike, with <lote>, those that are not, written as one word: people or things that are not alike; after a noun, those who differ in it, as in {ngaihsutna kibanglote}, those of different views

terms: in the same way/just the same
definition: <kibang> same with the emphatic <mah> and the suffix <in>; another spelling of <kibangmahin>

terms: in the same way/just the same
definition: <kibang> same with the emphatic <mah> and the suffix <in>
<kibang> and <pian.2> written as one word: be about the same as, look like; the thing compared with is followed by <tawh>
<kibang>, be alike, with the causative <sak>: make or treat one as the same as another; <tawh> marks the one compared with
<kibangsak>, make like, with the linking suffix <in>; <tawh> marks the one compared with
<kibang>, be like, with <ta>, marking a state now reached: after <tawh>, have become like

terms: those that are like/those that seem
definition: <kibang>, be like, with the plural <te>: those that are like or seem; it follows <tawh>
<kibang>, be like, with <zaw>, more or rather: after <tawh>, be more like
<kiban>, be equal to, with <pih>, together with: have the same aim, wish or quality as another
<baptaiz>, baptize, a loanword from English, with the passive prefix <ki>: be baptized
<kibaptaiz>, be baptized, with the noun suffix <na>: the baptism that one receives
<kibaptaiz>, be baptized, with the plural <te>

terms: owe one another/be in debt to each other
definition: <ba>, owe, with <ki>, each other, and <sak>: owe one another something
used with <tawh>, with: be like someone or something
with <tawh>: being as another is, or seeming as if something were so
alike, the same as each other; {a kibat kei leh} is if they are not alike
<kibat> and <loh> written as one word: not being alike; {kibatloh hang} is although not the same, and {kibatloh na} is a difference
the fact of not being alike, a difference: <kibat> be alike, <loh> not, with the noun suffix <na>
<kibatlohna>, difference, with the plural <te>: the ways in which people or things are not alike
how one thing is like another, or what two have in common; {tawh a kibatna} is likeness to something
<kibatna>, likeness, with the plural <te>: the ways in which one is like or equal to another, as in {Pasian tawh kibatnate}, equality with God

terms: be like/be alike with/be equal to
definition: <kibat> be like with <pih> together with: be like another; {ka kibatpih ding}, one for me to be like, my equal

<kibatpih> with the plural <te>: those who share the thing named before it, as {biakna kibatpihte}, people of the same religion, {tan kibatpihte}, classmates, and {lungsim kibatpihte}, the like-minded
passive of <bawl>, make or do: be made, prepared or done; with <tawh>, made of or prepared with something
of a sick or injured person: be given medical treatment, at a hospital or with medicine, as in {zatui tawh kibawl}; the one treated is the subject, not a thing that is made
<kibawl> be made with the linking <a>; {kibawla a om}, be in a prepared state
<ki> oneself with <bawl> make, repeated: be making oneself into something
passive use of {kibawlbawl}: a thing is made or prepared, again and again or in various ways, often with <pan> for what it is made from; not making oneself into something

terms: be made in addition/be done further/be added
definition: the prefix <ki> with <bawlbeh> written as one word: more of something is made or done; {thu kibawlbeh} is further action or a further charge is brought
<kibawl>, be done, and <den>, always, written as one word: be done or held again and again, as a custom

terms: will be held/will be done/will be made
definition: <kibawl> and <ding> written as one word: will be held, done or made; <thu kibawlding> is legal action will be taken, and {zatui kibawlding in} is in order to be treated
form of <kibawl>, be made, with the linking suffix <in>: being made, and then going on to what follows
<kibawl>, be made, with <kha>, happen to: be made as it happened, mostly {Record kibawlkha}, be caught on a recording
<kibawl>, be made, with <khia>, out, written as one word: be made and brought out, of goods, models and products
<kibawl>, be made, with <khiat>, out, written as one word: the form of <kibawlkhia> used before words such as <hangin> and <mateng>

terms: have been made/have been done/have been held
definition: <kibawl>, be made or done, and <khin>, already, written as one word: already made, filed, carried out or held
passive <ki> with <bawlkhol>, prepare beforehand: be made ready in advance
<kibawlkhol>, be prepared in advance, with <sa>, already: prepared and waiting

terms: be made again/be redone/be renewed/be held again
definition: <kibawl>, be made or done, and <kik>, again, written as one word: a card is renewed, a report is made again, an event is held again

terms: need to be treated/have to be done
definition: <kibawl>, be treated or be done, and <kul>, be necessary, written as one word; {zatui kibawlkul} is have to receive medical treatment

terms: still be done/be held again/be still under way
definition: <kibawl>, be done or be held, with <lai>, still: it is still being done, or with <ding> it will yet be held
<kibawl>, be made, and <lam>, the fact or way, written as one word: that or how something is made; {a kibawllam i mu hi} is we see that it is made

terms: not be made/not be done/not be held
definition: <kibawl>, be made or done, and <lo>, not, written as one word; {thu kibawllo} is no case is brought, no action is taken

terms: will not be held/will not be done
definition: <kibawllo>, not be done, and <ding>, will, written as one word: will not be held or carried out; {thu kibawlloding} is no case will be brought
noun form of <kibawl>, be made or done: the act, place or means of something being done; {pawi kibawlna inn} is a house where a feast is held
the medical treatment of a disease or of a patient, with <natna>, disease, <zatui>, medicine, or the name of an illness: {kibawlna mun} is a place of treatment; not the making or holding of something

terms: for treatment/for holding/in order to be done
definition: <kibawl>, be done or be treated, and <nading>, for, written as one word: for something to be done or held; after <zatui>, for medical treatment
plural of <kibawlna> in the sense of something being held: the times or occasions on which a feast, jubilee or celebration was held

terms: have been held before/have been done before
definition: <kibawl> and <ngei> written as one word: was once held, made or done

terms: be done at once/be carried out immediately
definition: <kibawl>, be made or done, and <pah>, at once, written as one word: is done, made or given right away, of a report, an operation or treatment
<bawlpha> put right with <ki>, passive or of oneself: mend one's ways under correction, or be made new
form of <kibawlpha> used before <kik>, <hun> and similar words: be put right again, of a broken jar, a ruined city or a person who mends his ways

terms: be done first/be made for now
definition: <kibawl>, be made or done, and <phot>, first or for the time being, written as one word: be done first, be set up or filed for the time being
<kibawl> and <pih> written as one word: be made, done or held for someone or together with someone, as a service, a report or paperwork
<kibawl>, be made, with <sa>, already done: made, prepared or finished beforehand; {a kibawlsa na} is the thing that has been made
<kibawl>, be made, with <sak>: be made or done on behalf of someone, as atonement made for the people

terms: will be held for/will be arranged for
definition: <kibawlsak>, be made or done for someone, and <ding>, will, written as one word: something will be held or arranged for someone

terms: not be made for/not be given treatment
definition: <kibawlsak>, be made or done for someone, and <lo>, not, written as one word: not be made for someone, and of medical treatment, not be given
that by which something is made for someone: <kibawlsak> be made for, with the noun suffix <na>; of the ram with which atonement is made for a person

terms: be planned/be about to be held
definition: <kibawl>, be made or held, with <sawm>, intend, written as one word: something is planned or intended to be done or held
<bawlsia>, mistreat, with the passive <ki>: be treated badly, harmed or persecuted by others
<bawlsia>, mistreat, with <ki> in its sense of each other: hurt or wrong one another
passive of <bawlsiat>; with <hong>, to be persecuted by others
the persecution or torment that people suffer; also of people provoking or harming one another, {khat leh khat kibawlsiatna}

terms: acts of mistreatment/wrongs done to one another
definition: <kibawlsiatna> with plural <te>
<kibawl> with <ta>, which marks that the thing has now happened, written as one word; {thu kibawlta} is a case has been brought, the person has been charged in court

terms: make oneself/make oneself out to be
definition: <bawltawm> with <ki>, of oneself: make oneself into something, as unclean by what one touches, or like an angel in appearance
{a kibawltawm} before a noun: made by people, not natural
things that are made, fashioned or carved, as {lim kibawlte} carved figures

terms: can be made/can be done/can be held
definition: <kibawl>, be made or done, and <thei>, able, written as one word

terms: can be done/may be brought/can be made
definition: <kibawlthei> and <ding> written as one word: it will be possible to do it; {thu kibawltheiding} is a case can be brought, charges may be laid
<kibawl> and <theih> written as one word: that can be done, made or treated; {kibawltheih zahzah} is as much as can be done

terms: can still be made/can still be done
definition: <kibawlthei> and <lai>, still, written as one word: it is still possible to have it made

terms: keep being done/be carried on/be done onward
definition: <kibawl> in the sense be made or done with <to>, onward, written as one word: be done or made on and on, step by step
<kibawl> be made with <zawh>, finished; {a kibawlzawh}, after it was made
<kibawl>, be done or held, with <zel>, repeatedly, written as one word: of an event or operation, be held time after time

terms: be held successfully/be able to be done
definition: <kibawl>, be made or held, and <zo>, manage to, written as one word: of a meeting or task, be carried through; with a negative, cannot be done
<beel>, rely on or attach oneself to, with the passive prefix <ki>: be the one that others attach themselves to; a second use, said of houses after a disaster, is not clear
<beh> clan with <ki>, one another: belong to the same family; {a kibeh} is a relative
in {kibeh laplap}, keep being added, pile up
be added to a number or group; <tawh> names what one is added to

terms: keep increasing/be added more and more
definition: <kibehlap>, be added, with its last syllable repeated: keep being added, grow more and more in number or amount
<kibehlap>, be added, with the noun suffix {-na}: an addition to a number or group, as a new member of a household
<kibehlap> be added with the causative <sak>: add people to a group
<kibehlap> and <te> written as one word: those who are added, as a wife or husband added to a household
<kibehlap> be added with <to>, upward or on top

terms: be spent/be used up/come to an end
definition: <bei>, come to an end, with the prefix <ki>: of money, time or a rule, be used up or come to an end; {kibei sak} is bring to an end

terms: have been spent/be used up already
definition: <kibei>, be spent, and <khin>, already, written as one word: of money or time, has already been spent
passive <ki> with <beimangsak>, destroy

terms: be wiped out/be exterminated/be brought to an end
definition: passive <ki> with <beisak>, bring to an end: be wiped out or made to cease
of money, be spent on something; comes after a sum of money, as in {$8 million kibeisak}, where the other sense is of a thing made to cease

terms: attach oneself/join together/lean on one another
definition: <bel>, cling to, with the prefix <ki>: attach oneself to, hold together with others; {kibel pawl gam} is a federal union of states
<ki> with <belh>, cling to: be stuck or pasted on something, as a sticker or a notice; {kibelh lap} is be added on top
<ki> with <bel>, lean on, and <pawl>, group: join with another as an ally; the ally is marked with <tawh>
the joining of states, peoples or parties into one body, used for a federal union and for a coalition of parties
be struck with the open hand; {khut kibeng} is the hands are clapped, there is applause, and {apang kibeng} is be slapped on the cheek
passive <ki> with <bet> strike
with <khiat>, out: be pulled up out of the ground
the act of being pulled up or out, with the noun suffix <na>
passive of <bia>, worship: be worshipped
give oneself as an offering to God
form of <kibia>, be worshipped, used before words such as <leh> and <hun>; with <tawh> it is a sacrifice being made with something
the worshipping of God or a god; {kibiakna mun} is the place where he is worshipped, a sanctuary
what is offered to the Lord in worship
<kibiakna> offering with plural <te>: the things offered in worship; {keimah hong kibiaknate}, the offerings made to me
<bilhcip>, shut in, with the prefix <ki>: be closed in and not go out; the book gives it as the opposite of <vakthap>, go about from place to place
be bowed down flat; used with {kikun}, be bent over
<kibokcip> be pressed down with the causative <sak>
hang together on something like a bunch, as vessels hung on a peg; perhaps from <bom>, cluster

terms: be uprooted/be pulled up/be torn out
definition: passive <ki> with <botkhia>, pull out: be pulled up by the roots, or be torn out of its place
of a cord or snare: be pulled until it breaks, from <bot>, pull
camp of Israel in the wilderness between Sinai and Hazeroth, where the people who craved meat were buried
camp of Israel in the wilderness before Hazeroth, named graves of craving because the people who craved meat were buried there
passive <ki> with <bu>, hide: be hidden or kept secret
passive of <bua>, pour: be poured out or shed, said of blood, water or anger
<buai>, be troubled, with <ki>: be in disorder and noise, said of a crowd
have the hands full with work or a matter, named with <tawh> or <vai>, without the noise of a crowd; {kibuai pih} after a place with <ah> is be occupied or engaged there
<kibuai> be in confusion with <gawp>, violently
<kibuaigawp> be thrown into confusion with the causative <sak>
<kibuai>, be in turmoil with one another, with the noun suffix <na>: trouble or fighting between people or groups; {minam vai kibuaina} is ethnic conflict

terms: be attended to/be dealt with/be busy with
definition: <buai>, be occupied, with <ki> and the suffix <pih>: be busied with a matter; in community notices, said of a person whose case at a hospital, an office, a court or a lockup is being taken care of
passive <ki> with <buaisak>, trouble, disturb
passive of <buak>: a liquid is poured or sprinkled on someone, blood is shed
throw dust or ashes over oneself as a sign of grief
<kibua>, be poured, with <khia>, out: be poured or spilled out
<kibuak> with the linking suffix <in>: putting dust or ashes on oneself as a sign of grief
<kibuak>, be poured out, with the noun suffix <na>: the place where something is poured or thrown out; {vut kibuakna} is the ash heap
the prefix <ki> with <bual>, wallow: roll or bathe in water, and so be sunk in or given over to something, as in {siatna sungah kibual}, wallow in evil
be seized and used with violence; said of women when a city is taken
two people or sides seize each other and struggle, as a sport at a feast or in a fight, often with <tawh>, with; no violation is meant
the sport of wrestling, two people struggling to throw each other; in news of war also violent assault on women
<kibuan>, be violated, with <sak>: said of women forced by men
<kibua> be poured out, with <sa> for a completed action; said of blood
<kibu> and <cip> written as one word: hide oneself away so as not to be found
<buk>, take cover, with the prefix <ki>: shelter or hide oneself, also under the protection of an organisation
a place where one takes cover or hides, such as a bomb shelter or a hideout; {kibukna mun} is a place of refuge
<buksan>, hide from, with the prefix <ki>: hide oneself away from others
passive <ki> with <bulh>, put on or fasten: be fixed onto something, set in a mounting or grafted in; {kol kibulh} and {sikkol kibulh} mean be put in chains
of a song: the words and the tune, {la-aw}, are joined to each other, with <tawh> for the other part, as a hymn text is set to a tune; not a thing fastened on a body or an object
<kibulh>, be fastened on, with the linking suffix <in>: being bound, said of chains or fetters put on a person
<kibulh> be put on with <sa>, already: of lamps set on a stand, or of people put in chains
the passive prefix <ki> with <bulhsak>, put on someone, written as one word; {kol kibulhsak} is have shackles or handcuffs put on
<kibulh> be fastened with <tawm>, of oneself: fix oneself on a course of one's own accord
the prefix <ki> with <bul>, beginning, and <pat>, begin: make a start from the very beginning, or be started

terms: be taken as the basis/be based on
definition: passive <ki> with <bulphuh> base on
<buluak>, seize by force, with the passive prefix <ki>: of a camp or base, be attacked and taken
passive <ki> with <buluh>, plunder: be raided and stripped of goods
of a place or a group, be entered suddenly by the police or officers who search it and arrest people; no goods are robbed, unlike the plundering of the other sense
<kibuluh>, be raided, with the noun suffix <na>: the raiding of a house, or the seizing of power by force

terms: be bewitched/be put under a spell
definition: passive <ki> with <bum> bewitch

terms: go into hiding/hide away/flee and hide
definition: <kibu>, hide, with <mang>, away, written as one word: people hide away out of sight, as in the forest during an attack
of a car, bus, lorry or boat: turn over in an accident
<kibung>, overturn, with the linking <in>, written as one word: a vehicle or boat overturns and something follows
<ki> oneself with <bup> whole; in {kibup piak}, give oneself wholly, devote oneself, elsewhere written as one word <kibuppiak>
<ki> oneself with <buppiak> give wholly
of a camp, post or town in war: be attacked by a force that closes in on it
of vehicles: run into each other or into something; {mawtaw kibut} is a car crash
<kibut>, crash, with the noun ending {-na}: the crash of a vehicle or the wreck of a ship, a road or sea accident
town in the hill country of Ephraim, given with its pasturelands to the Kohathite Levites
